description: This script analyzes a TypeScript/JavaScript source file to identify low-level calls related to reading request body content in webhook handlers, particularly for security enforcement.

methods.name: getCalleeName
methods.description: Extracts the callee name from an expression, used to identify specific function calls within the source file.

methods.name: findBlockedWebhookBodyReadLines
methods.description: Parses the source content to find lines where certain blocked functions (like reading request bodies) are called.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that runs the webhook guard detection logic with specified parameters.
